object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Acknowledge a link, then commit (a) adding a figure to the target, (b) removing the target's figure; and find the last change of an object whose figure was added, or changed, after its object file. Expected: the link reads suspect after each figure commit, with that commit as the last change; acknowledging after a figure-only commit records the figure commit and the link reads OK; the last change is the figure commit.
